design_notes: Not a VP, but 'Team Members may upgrade to first class by personally paying the cost of the upgrade' at ticketing (lines 145-149): the cheapest first-class fare (Delta), the traveller paying the difference from coach, or first class on the American flight that carries the lowest coach fare: 'the best available coach' (line 147) reads as the lowest coach fare overall or the upgraded flight's own, and the American upgrade keeps FXO at the lowest logical coach airfare (line 135) on both readings (validation w2). The non-reimbursement of upgrades (lines 174-175, 815) does not stop the traveller paying their own.
